caption: The drawing depicts a single fork positioned vertically in the center of a plain, cream or beige-colored background. The fork features a long, rounded handle with visible wood grain texture, rendered in shades of gray and black to suggest a wooden material. The handle tapers at its end where it connects to the metal portion, which is slightly narrower and features two circular accents before broadening into the head of the fork. The head of the fork consists of three evenly spaced straight tines, also drawn in shades of gray. There are no other objects, patterns, or colors present in the composition.
title: Silver Fork
